failures.question: How many active customers did we have at the end of Q3 2011?
failures.example_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id) FROM dim_customer WHERE first_invoice_date < '2011-10-01' AND (last_invoice_date >= '2011-10-01' OR last_invoice_date IS NULL)

failures.question: How many customers had churned as of the end of June 2011?
failures.example_sql: WITH customer_activity AS (SELECT customer_id, MAX(invoice_date) as last_purchase_date FROM fact_sales WHERE invoice_date < '2011-07-01' GROUP BY customer_id) SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customer_activity WHERE last_purchase_date < '2011-06-01'

failures.question: What was our churn rate at the end of 2010?
What was our average order value (AOV) in 2011?
failures.example_sql: SELECT SUM(revenue) / COUNT(DISTINCT invoice) AS aov FROM fact_sales WHERE invoice_date >= '2011-01-01' AND invoice_date < '2012-01-01'

failures.question: What was the cancellation rate in 2010?
failures.example_sql: WITH sales_2010 AS (SELECT SUM(revenue) AS total_revenue FROM fact_sales WHERE invoice_date >= '2010-01-01' AND invoice_date < '2011-01-01'), cancellations_2010 AS (SELECT SUM(revenue) AS total_cancellations FROM fact_cancellations WHERE invoice_date >= '2010-01-01' AND invoice_date < '2011-01-01') SELECT (ABS(COALESCE(c.total_cancellations, 0)) / NULLIF(COALESCE(s.total_revenue, 0) + ABS(COALESCE(c.total_cancellations, 0)), 0)) * 100 AS cancellation_rate_percentage FROM sales_2010 s CROSS JOIN cancellations_2010 c

failures.question: What was our international revenue in 2011?
failures.example_sql: SELECT SUM(revenue) AS international_revenue FROM fact_sales WHERE country != 'United Kingdom' AND invoice_date >= '2011-01-01' AND invoice_date < '2012-01-01'

failures.question: How many large orders did we receive in 2011?
What share of 2010 revenue came in peak season?
failures.example_sql: WITH annual_revenue AS (SELECT SUM(revenue) AS total_revenue FROM fact_sales WHERE invoice_date >= '2010-01-01' AND invoice_date < '2011-01-01'), peak_revenue AS (SELECT SUM(s.revenue) AS peak_rev FROM fact_sales s JOIN dim_date d ON s.date_key = d.date_key WHERE s.invoice_date >= '2010-01-01' AND s.invoice_date < '2011-01-01' AND d.month IN (10, 11, 12)) SELECT (peak_rev / total_revenue) * 100 AS peak_season_revenue_share FROM annual_revenue, peak_revenue
